name: report_findings
description: Report every concrete localization defect found in this batch. Call exactly once, with an empty list if the batch is clean.

findings.description: One entry per defect. Empty when nothing is wrong.

string_id.description: The exact string id as given in the batch, including any attribute suffix.

file.description: The exact file path as given in the batch.

category.description: A functional/markup, B mistranslation/wrong name/brand, C grammar/spelling, D terminology/register, E typography.

impact.description: 1 broken output, 2 wrong content, 3 degraded language, 4 cosmetic.

summary.description: One sentence stating the defect. No preamble.

current.description: The exact defective fragment copied verbatim from the localized string. Used to verify later whether the defect is gone, so it must appear literally in the current text.

suggest.description: The corrected text for that fragment.

rationale.description: Why it is wrong, referring to the en-US meaning or the developer comment.

confidence.description: Use medium only if you would still stand behind reporting it; anything lower should not be reported at all.
